registryBasis: Official Weihai government pages identify the Weihai Natural Resources and Planning Bureau Wendeng planning branch and the Weihai Real Estate Registration Center Wendeng branch. The official service guidance identifies Shandong's public geographic-information platform and the cadastral categories available in its map module. This evidences a local registry/map custodian, not open parcel geometry access.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Wendeng District land and real-estate registration/cadastral services under the Weihai municipal natural-resources and registration system.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official Weihai government page retrieved; identifies the Weihai Natural Resources and Planning Bureau Wendeng planning branch and its planning-management responsibility. No parcel API link was present.
Official Weihai natural-resources page retrieved; identifies the Wendeng registration-center branch and contact information. No anonymous geometry endpoint was linked.

Official current guidance retrieved. It directs users to the Shandong geographic-information public-service platform and describes the cadastral map categories, including cadastral districts, subdistricts and construction-land parcels.

Current official Shandong map viewer shell retrieved. JavaScript/configuration was inspected; it exposed the viewer base configuration and general service hosts, but no safe anonymous Wendeng parcel ID-plus-geometry request was identified. No exact-point or bbox query was submitted.
Official Weihai digital convenience-map page retrieved. It is a general public map and did not expose a safe cadastral parcel response in the fetched HTML/JavaScript.

Official Wendeng government registration-publicity page retrieved; confirms the local natural-resources bureau and registration-center role. It contains protected registration-publicity information, which was not retained as parcel data.

technicalBlocker: No public anonymous map/API route returning a safe native parcel identifier plus geometry was exposed. The official guidance identifies the public viewer but does not provide a qualifying endpoint in the current fetched configuration.
remainingUncertainty: No exact-point hit or bounded parcel bbox query was performed. A zero hit, unavailable map extent, timeout or unusable UI would not establish citywide absence. The exact WUP coordinate was preserved and not shifted.
nextStep: On a later attempt, inspect any newly published official Shandong/Weihai/Wendeng viewer configuration for a bounded anonymous cadastral ID-plus-geometry response and qualify any adapter independently before runtime admission.
